name: Pact Trait : Eyes of the Patron
description: You lose your Normal Vision, but gain Echo Location up to 20 Units and +1 Search.

name: Pact Trait : Silvered Tongue
description: You gain +1 Persuasion and your Patrons Magical Language. When you roll a 1 on a Persuasion Check, you cannot speak or Channel Spells until you complete a Full Rest.

name: Pact Trait : Enamoring Melody
description: You gain +2 Performance. When you roll a 1 on a Performance Check while playing an Instrument, Singing or attempting a Ballad, everyone who can hear you must make a Resistance Check of 10 or higher or become Maddened for 1 Minute.

name: Pact Trait : Fractured Mind
description: You gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage but you cannot Focus on anything.

name: Pact Trait : Corrupted Vessel
description: You gain +15 Health but are permanently Diseased and cannot recover Health. At the end of each Full Rest, recover all your Health.

name: Pact Trait : Sylvan
description: You can Speak to Animals and Plants at will, but you lose -2 Persuasion and -2 Insight.

name: Pact Trait : Holy Burden
description: You lose -5 Physical Mitigation but your Healing Spells restore an additional 5 Health.

name: Pact Trait : Wild Binding
description: With 2 Actions, you can Transform into a Beast of Level 2 or lower. While you are in contact with Iron, take 1d4 True Damage at the start of your turn unless you have 1 or less Health.

name: Pact Trait : Patrons Fury
description: When you are Critically Hit, the Attack is downgraded to a normal Hit but you become Maddened for 1d4 Turns.

name: Pact Trait : Patrons Magic
description: You can only Channel Magic from your Patrons School, but you gain +2 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage.

name: Pact Trait : Broken Will
description: You gain +1 Attack and +1 Damage with all Weapons but lose -2 Resistance.

name: Pact Trait : Forbidden Knowledge
description: You gain +1 Arcana, Academics and Medicine Knowledge but lose -1 Block and -1 Dodge

name: Pact Trait : Bound Soul
description: You cannot be resurrected, but whenever you make a Lifeline Check, the die becomes a 10.

name: Beastkin Trait : Landwalker
description: Gain +1 Movement Speed and +1 Wilderness Knowledge.

name: Beastkin Trait : Seawalker
description: You can Breathe Underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Movement Speed.

name: Beastkin Trait : Cloudwalker
description: You are Good at the Search Skill.

name: Lycanthrope Weakness : Fire Weakness
description: Your Lycanthropy has manifested in a fear of fire. You suffer a -4 Penalty to your Fire Mitigation. Any time you take Fire Damage, you must make a Resilience Check greater than or equal to half the Fire Damage taken or become Afraid of whatever caused the Damage. You cannot willfully move within 2 Units of an open flame while in Lycanthrope form.

name: Lycanthrope Weakness : Water Weakness
description: Your Lycanthropy has manifested in a fear of fire. You suffer a -4 Penalty to your Cold Mitigation. Any time you take Cold Damage, you must make a Resilience Check greater than or equal to half the Cold Damage taken or become Afraid of whatever caused the Damage. You cannot willfully cross a boundry or body of water while in Lycanthrope form.

name: Lycanthrope Weakness : Silver Weakness
description: Your Lycanthropy has manifested in an aversion to Silver. Weapons that are Silvered deal True Damage to you. Whenever you first come in contact with a Silver Object or end your turn holding a Silver Object in your Inventory, you take 1d6 True Damage. This includes Touch Spells that use Silver as a Component.

name: Small Creature
description: Small Creatures gain +1 Dodge and Stealth while having a -1 penalty to Movement Speed and Strength. They cannot wield Heavy Weapons and have a decreased carrying capacity.

name: Medium Creature
description: Medium Creatures are standard size, gaining no penalties or bonuses.

name: Large Creature
description: Large creatures gain a +1 Strength and Block while having a -1 penalty to Stealth, Acrobatics and Dodge.They must consume 4 Meals per day to qualify for the benefits from a Full Rest. Additionally, they take up double the space of a normal creature but have an increased carrying capacity.
